title: A comprehensive analysis of transcription factors identified TCF3 as a prognostic target for glioma.
authors: Li, Qiao; Feng, Peng; Liu, Shangyu; Tian, Goupeng; Yuan, Guoqiang; Pan, Yawen
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过机器学习分析胶质瘤转录因子表达谱并鉴定预后标志物TCF3，但未涉及TF-DNA结合位点预测、互作界面或三维结构建模，仅属表达层面的生物信息学分析，与本课题核心方法脱节。
abstract: Transcription factors (TFs) are pivotal in tumor initiation and progression, regulating downstream gene expression and modulating cellular processes. In this study, we conducted a comprehensive analysis of TF gene sets to define the molecular subtypes of gliomas. Using nonnegative matrix factorization (NMF), we identified two distinct glioma subtypes characterized by significant differences in survival outcomes and clinical features. Additionally, we identified TF gene sets with differential expression across gliomas of various World Health Organization (WHO) states, followed by protein‒protein interaction (PPI) network analysis. By applying 101 machine learning models, five key genes (EZH2, TWIST1, EGR1, FOSL2, and TCF3) involved in glioma were identified. Among these genes, TCF3 has emerged as a potential key prognostic marker because of its distinct expression patterns and functional relevance. By performing multi-omics and multi-dataset analyses, we explored the aberrant expression of TCF3 across multiple cancers, with robust validation at both the cellular and tissue levels. Furthermore, our analysis revealed a strong association between TCF3 mutation and glioma prognosis, underscoring its potential as a therapeutic target. In summary, this study not only introduces a novel method for the molecular subtyping of glioma but also highlights TCF3 as a promising target for precision medicine. Our findings provide crucial insights into the molecular mechanisms of glioma and offer a foundation for the development of novel therapeutic strategies.
abstract_zh: 转录因子（TFs）在肿瘤发生和进展中起关键作用，调控下游基因表达并调节细胞过程。在本研究中，我们对转录因子基因集进行了全面分析，以定义胶质瘤的分子亚型。利用非负矩阵分解（NMF），我们识别出两种不同的胶质瘤亚型，其特征在生存结果和临床特征方面存在显著差异。此外，我们识别了在不同世界卫生组织（WHO）状态的胶质瘤中差异表达的转录因子基因集，随后进行了蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络分析。通过应用101种机器学习模型，我们确定了五个参与胶质瘤的关键基因（EZH2、TWIST1、EGR1、FOSL2和TCF3）。在这些基因中，TCF3因其独特的表达模式和功能相关性而成为潜在的关键预后标志物。通过进行多组学和多数据集分析，我们探讨了TCF3在多种癌症中的异常表达，并在细胞和组织水平上进行了稳健验证。此外，我们的分析揭示了TCF3突变与胶质瘤预后之间的强关联，强调了其作为治疗靶点的潜力。总之，本研究不仅引入了一种新的胶质瘤分子分型方法，还突出了TCF3作为精准医学中一个有前景的靶点。我们的发现为胶质瘤的分子机制提供了关键见解，并为开发新型治疗策略奠定了基础。
